description: Verifies the code the guest received by email for a booking_id, then holds an available room and submits the reservation for staff confirmation within 24 hours. Requires that booking_id and six-digit code. Repeating the same valid pair returns the same reservation. After email proof, checks stays matching only that proved email, overlapping dates and the 30-day continuous-stay limit, including a one-night gap. Starting over with the proved email for the same property, room type and dates returns the existing held chat reservation. Contact-based refusals give only the requested stay link and property phone. The guest brings photo ID and signs the guest agreement at check-in; no payment is taken.

booking_id.description: Opaque identifier returned by the first step.

code.description: The six-digit code received by the guest by email.
